definitions: a small soluble case of gelatin containing a dose of medicine.
a small case or container, especially a round or cylindrical one.
a concise summary of a text or event.
a detachable compartment of a spacecraft.
examples: He took a capsule for his headache.
The time capsule was buried in the park.
The news report provided a capsule of the day's events.
The astronauts returned to Earth in their capsule.
